# SHA-256 checksums of the toy dataset files.
# This file is regenerated by data/make_toy_dataset.py after each run.
# The empty state below means the CSVs have only the header row (schema).
#
# To regenerate the toy dataset and update this file:
#     python data/make_toy_dataset.py --synthetic --seed 42
#
# See data/toy_dataset/README.md for the real-vs-synthetic distinction.
#
# Format: <sha256>  <filename>
#
# e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855  benign_sample.csv
# (hash of empty file above; will be replaced on first generation)
# e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855  malicious_sample.csv
# (hash of empty file above; will be replaced on first generation)
